[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Hey, Shulk... What's it like[XENO:n ]
being able to see the future?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]It's kinda hard to explain.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]If I had to describe it, it's like[XENO:n ]
I'm being made to watch a dream.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]A dream, huh? That's[XENO:n ]
one strange power.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Tell me, Carna... What do you[XENO:n ]
think of my power?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・I wish I had it./・I still don't quite believe it. ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]If I had your power, maybe[XENO:n ]
I could have saved Colony 6.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Yeah, you're[XENO:n ]
right. I know.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And then there's[XENO:n ]
Gado-san...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]Yeah. But honestly, the[XENO:n ]
more I think about it...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The more I realise none of this[XENO:n ]
could have been helped.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And your power kept Juujuu safe.[XENO:n ]
I'll always be grateful for that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Yeah, that was a close one.[XENO:n ]
I'm glad we got to him in time.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Otherwise there could have been[XENO:n ]
a future where Juujuu didn't make it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

Thank goodness for[XENO:n ]
your visions.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]If you have a vision, it means...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・There's nothing to fear!/・You can save someone's life! ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]But it doesn't work like that.[XENO:n ]
Some things I can't see.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Even if I do see someone dying,[XENO:n ]
I might not be able to stop it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I couldn't stop what[XENO:n ]
happened to Fiorung.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No, I suppose not.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I'm sorry. I didn't mean to bring[XENO:n ]
up bad memories.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I could see it, just as it was[XENO:n ]
about to happen.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But I was still powerless[XENO:n ]
to save her.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I guess I misunderstood.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]What do you mean?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The ability to have these visions...[XENO:n ]
It's not without its consequences.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]It means you can help people, but[XENO:n ]
it's a heavy burden as well.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Thank you, Carna. I feel[XENO:n ]
better from talking to you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I can't see the future.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But I'm good at solving[XENO:n ]
problems I can see.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Talk to me about[XENO:n ]
anything, anytime![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I feel like a stronger person[XENO:n ]
when I'm around you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

That's kind of you to say.[XENO:n ]
Thank you, Carna.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
What is it?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I can't see everything. Sometimes[XENO:n ]
the visions are quite hazy.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And even when I've seen the[XENO:n ]
future, I can't always change it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Are you talking about...[XENO:n ]
what happened to Fiorung?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]Yeah.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I'm also worried about what's[XENO:n ]
going to happen to Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I've hardly been able to see[XENO:n ]
anything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]If only my power wasn't[XENO:n ]
so limited...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Don't be so hard on yourself![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You've saved us how[XENO:n ]
many times now?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Yeah, I guess I have![XENO:n ]
Thanks, Carna![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But I still wish I could master[XENO:n ]
my power a bit better.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]If there's anything I can do[XENO:n ]
to help, just let me know![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I'll support you all the way![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:type type=anger ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]What?! All this time, and you[XENO:n ]
still don't believe me?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]No! That's not what I meant at all.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
What did you mean then?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]It's just...such an[XENO:n ]
unbelievable thing.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Even as I think about it now,[XENO:n ]
I can't fathom how you can do it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Oh, I see what you're saying now.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Actually, I kind of feel[XENO:n ]
the same way.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Maybe I'll never understand it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Carna, if you could have[XENO:n ]
one vision of the future...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]What would you want to see?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・Juujuu getting married./・How Colony 6 turns out. ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]That's what you want to see?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Hey! It's my vision and it can[XENO:n ]
be anything I want![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Don't you have any brothers or[XENO:n ]
sisters you want to know about?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
No, I'm an only child.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Do you know how worried I[XENO:n ]
am about my little brother?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]What if Juujuu gets taken[XENO:n ]
in by some strange woman...?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Oh, I didn't think of that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I'm sorry. That sounds important.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I'm very protective of him.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Not long after we were born,[XENO:n ]
we lost both our parents.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I became like a mother to him.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I see.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I envy Juujuu for having[XENO:n ]
an older sister like you, Carna.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I can't stop wondering about the[XENO:n ]
day the colony is back to normal.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]It used to be a fun, bustling place.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]That's the home I remember, and[XENO:n ]
I want it back the way it was.[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Carna... I...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]And not just that...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:type type=think ][XENO:jaw jaw=off ]I wonder about who's going to be[XENO:n ]
by my side, enjoying it with me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Carna? What were you gonna say?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Oh, nothing. The point is...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I might not have your power, but[XENO:n ]
I'm gonna get my home back![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]And I'll be there to help you.[XENO:n ]
We'll fix it together![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
